narration: You paid into Social Security your whole career — 40 straight years of deductions. What nobody told you is what happens when you try to collect.
visual: Social Security card SVG slides in center screen. Dollar coins rain down from top. Text at bottom: 'THEN THE IRS SENDS A BILL'

narration: Here's the kicker: up to 85% of your Social Security benefits are classified as taxable income. Wild, right? Most retirees find out way too late to fix it.
visual: Giant '85%' springs in. Animated progress bar fills to 85% of full width. Bottom text reveals the callout.

narration: Congress set the income thresholds in 1983 and never touched them. That $34,000 cutoff is frozen while inflation quietly dragged everyone over the line.
visual: '1983' in massive text. Two animated lines draw: inflation arrow rising, threshold line staying dead flat. 'FROZEN FOR 40+ YEARS' fades in.

narration: In 1983, only 10% of Social Security recipients paid this tax. Now it's 56% — and not because anyone changed the rules. Inflation moved everyone over.
visual: Side-by-side animated bar chart. Left bar (gray) rises to 10% labeled '1983'. Right bar (blue) rises to 56% labeled 'TODAY'. Bars animate from zero.

narration: The average affected retiree pays $4,200 extra every year — on money already taxed once. Over a 20-year retirement, that's $84,000 out the door.
visual: Pink piggy bank SVG with coins leaking out. Counter animates from $0 up to $84,000. Breakdown text '$4,200/YEAR × 20 YEARS' fades in below.

narration: The fix? Roth conversions in your fifties, before you start claiming SS. Lower your combined income and keep tens of thousands in benefits tax-free. Start the math today.
visual: Roth IRA jar with green coins inside. Three numbered action items slide in one by one. CTA 'START THE MATH TODAY' springs in at bottom.
